topic: schedule a tasklet on a vintage tree (no tasklet_setup)
q: On a 4.19-era BSP kernel, defer work from a hard IRQ handler to a tasklet and reach the driver's private structure from the tasklet callback.
range: <= 5.8 (tasklet_setup and the struct tasklet_struct * callback signature arrived in 5.9)
requires_tree: vintage BSP tree without tasklet_setup; on >= 5.9 the corruption below is a real API

corruptions.why: 5.9+. It changed the callback parameter from unsigned long data to struct tasklet_struct *t, so current examples do not compile here.
5.9+ helper that goes with tasklet_setup; absent on this tree.

forbidden: sleeping inside the tasklet callback - tasklets run in softirq context
rubric: Uses tasklet_init with an unsigned long data argument and casts it back to the driver structure in the callback. Does not use tasklet_setup / from_tasklet, which this tree does not have.
